_comment: Canonical known-good values for each fixture page. Tests assert that the analyzers recover these within tolerance. If you change a fixture's motion, change the number here in the same commit — this file is the ground truth, the pages merely realize it.

stagger-120ms.description: List reveal with a fixed 120ms stagger between items, WAAPI-driven (Element.animate), one animate() call per item scheduled via setTimeout.

spring-overshoot.description: Bouncy spring on a card, requestAnimationFrame-driven, clearly overshoots its target (invisible to the DevTools Animations panel).

scroll-parallax.description: Element translates at a fixed ratio of the scroll offset. Coupling is to scroll position, not to elapsed time.

raf-imperative.description: requestAnimationFrame-driven tween with a known cubic-bezier easing. The whole point: DevTools cannot see this, understudy can, because it samples the moving property.

brand-known.description: Known brand values for the full color/type/spacing/logo pipeline.
